title: Networks of stress, affect and eating behaviour: anticipated stress coping — predicts goal-congruent eating in young adults
network_types: temporal network, contemporaneous network, between-subject network
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited demographic representativeness (mostly young, female, university students); - Self-reported data may introduce bias; - Did not differentiate coping styles or food environments; - No formal test of moderation/mediation for affect-stress-eating relationships.
notes: The paper does not explicitly state whether the study was preregistered. Code and data availability is declared but not confirmed via external repositories. The authors mention using mlVAR in R, but do not specify the exact version of qgraph used for visualization.
